name: git-autopilot
description: Git workflow guardrails for Codex: branches, checkpoint commits, push and PR review reminders.

interface.shortDescription: Keep agent Git work on branches and checkpoint progress.
interface.longDescription: Protect main during agent work, checkpoint and push work branches at turn end, and require human PR merges. Hooks must be reviewed and trusted before use.
interface.defaultPrompt: Review my Git branch and suggest the next safe step.
